_comment: Cause split of the red res=sub candidates of the confound world, L300 only (synthetic traces only, no participants; .steering/20261015-rhythm-stage-speed-cause-split/design.md). The rows are rebuilt with the confound world's instrument (prev.dir, imported, not copied; its files and the e13.json / summary.json used by the gate are checked against prev.sha256 before anything runs, design 1.1). The confound world's config.json gives the generator settings, e13.folds and pc_stall.lam.<step> (the PC-stall of each candidate).
_comment_bins: design 1.3: lrbin = each A_speed column as the one-hot of bins quantile bins (edges on the training side of each fold, repeated edges dropped) next to its value; lrbin2 bins the stage columns too (descriptive).
_comment_drops: design 1.4: the stage quantities dropped (with their d1_ / d2_ differences in the full attacker). R2 is the main one, Rall drops all of r, A2 is the comparison on the a side.
_comment_read: design 3.2, 3.3: a candidate is read only when its PC-stall's lower bound max > pc_lower and point estimate max <= pc_upper (the confound world's stall_ok) and its PC0's upper bound max < margin (same variant); remains when its lower bound max > margin, vanishes when its upper bound max < margin.
_comment_versions: design 1.1: the versions of the confound world (its provenance.json); split.py stops on any other.
